notes.title: UPDATE - ACHIEVEMENTS AND MANUAL SAVING
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 16 Steam Achievements have been implemented. 
[*] Replaced the Autosave system with manual saving. A total of 20 save slots are now available. 
NOTE: Due to changing the save system, old save files from previous versions may be unable to load. This most commonly applies to save files that were NOT in slot 1. I apologize for any inconvenience. 
[*] Added a Fullscreen option in-game. 
[*] Slight changes to a few conversations. 
[/list]

tags.feature: Replaced the Autosave system with manual saving. A total of 20 save slots are now available.
